skins.description: Once a sentinel within the Command Line, Lucian has seen PROJECT for what they truly are. His dual ion-core Lightcaster pistols now serve G/NETIC and the human rebellion, bringing down their technological oppressors with brutal efficiency.

skins.description: Half man, half machine, and all justice, Detective Lucian Phoenix fights crime under the pastel palm trees of Demacia. Rebuilt out of polished chrome and gilded Piltovan carbon fiber following a fatal gunfight, this technological marvel dispenses vaporwave vengeance as a neon beacon of law and order.

skins.name: Pulsefire Lucian
skins.description: A dedicated chrono-enforcer, Lucian joined the Remembrancers when he lost his wife, Senna, in an errant Praetorian attack. Now, he searches for her while bringing justice to the reckless time travelers who would cavalierly tear holes in space-time.

skins.name: Prestige Pulsefire Lucian
skins.description: Through his work in bringing their opponents to justice, Lucian earned the personal attention and gratitude of Thresh, leader of the Remembrancers. Armed with special modifications to his Pulsefire suit, Lucian embarks on his relentless pursuit across timelines. Through it all, however, he can't shake the feeling that this upgrade isn't all it seems...

skins.description: Lucian believes in balance: that no one Archetype should have excessive influence on the world. With one gun amplifying patterns and the other canceling them out, Lucian maintains the world's fragile order within the new power vacuum—even as the likes of Tahm Kench move to fill it.

passive.name: Lightslinger
passive.description: Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot.

spells.name: Piercing Light
spells.description: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target.
spells.dynamicDescription: Lucian shoots a bolt of piercing light through an enemy unit, damaging enemies in a line for <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Deals <physicalDamage>@TotalMinionDamage@ damage</physicalDamage> to minions.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Ardent Blaze
spells.description: Lucian shoots a missile that explodes in a star shape, marking enemies. Lucian gains Movement Speed for attacking marked enemies.
spells.dynamicDescription:
Lucian fires a shot that explodes upon enemy contact or reaching the end of its path. The explosion deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and marks enemies for @DebuffDuration@ seconds.

Damaging marked targets grants Lucian @MoveSpeedAmount@ Move Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: Relentless Pursuit
spells.description: Lucian dashes a short distance, removing all slow effects.
spells.dynamicDescription: Lucian dashes a short distance, removing all <status>Slow</status> effects. If Lucian kills an enemy while <spellName>The Culling</spellName> is active, the cooldown of <spellName>Relentless Pursuit</spellName> is reset.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@

spells.name: The Culling
spells.description: Lucian unleashes a torrent of shots from his weapons.
spells.dynamicDescription:
Lucian moves freely while firing rapidly in a single direction for @Duration@ seconds. His shots collide with the first enemy they hit and each do @DamagePerBullet@ physical damage. The number of shots scales with his Attack Speed.

Total over @TotalNumShots@ shots: @TotalDamage@ physical damage.
The Culling does @PercentDamageAmpToMinions@% damage to minions.@SpellModifierDescriptionAppend@
